row.proto: uint8_t *Game_Make_MaskedUserId_FromPlatformString(uint8_t *out_id, uint32_t platform, const char *id_str, uint64_t extra)
row.notes: Maps a platform enum to an id type (1->1; 2-4,9-11,0x12-0x14->3; 5-7,0xc-0xe,0x15-0x17->4; 0xf-0x11->5; 0x1d-0x1f->6; default 8), converts id_str to a 64-bit number with 0x145350968 (strtoull-like, args 0,0) and calls Game_XorMaskedId3_Ctor(out, type, value, extra, c, 0) where c repeats the value only for type 6. Platform 0x19 instead fills out_id with Ne_Make_RandomIdBlock. Used by the online career manager to build player/career ids.
